title: Smoked tofu and leek bake
summary: Smoked tofu and leek bake is a british dinner built around smoked tofu and leeks, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Smoked tofu and leek bake into even pieces and toss leeks with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of leeks while you season smoked tofu. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle smoked tofu and new potatoes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Smoked tofu and leek bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Smoked tofu and leek bake into warm bowls with the juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
